approved_translation: Arise! Awake! Approach the wise and learn. Like the sharp edge of a razor is that path, so the wise say—hard to tread and difficult to cross.
context_summary: The Katha Upanishad famously urges the seeker to wake up from spiritual slumber and seek a true teacher. The path to Self-realization is as narrow and sharp as a razor's edge—difficult to walk but the only way to freedom. This is one of the most quoted passages in all Hindu scripture.
interpretation_boundaries: Show a figure awakening from sleep, stepping onto a narrow mountain path
Use imagery of dawn, a razor-sharp ridge, and a distant light
Emphasize the courage and determination of the spiritual seeker
